author: Harry Jaggard
description:
In this episode, Chris Rodriguez • Travelwithchris and I met in Lebanon to share our most dangerous and intense travel stories from around the world. We also emphasized the importance of travel safety and situational awareness, as many many of our worst experiences were fairly avoidable to be honest.
